description: Triage, medical screening examination (EMTALA), treatment, stabilization, and transfer; about 20 visits a day
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patient safety (allergies, medications, prior results unavailable); EMTALA screening duty continues regardless of IT status; after 4 hours without EHR, laboratory, and imaging support the ED cannot safely accept ambulance traffic and diversion is considered
manual_workaround: Paper ED record and downtime forms; downtime PC reports; phone results from the laboratory; transfer by paper packet
dependent_third_parties: EHR vendor; emergency physician group; county EMS; internet carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: ED nurses; contracted ED physicians; ED

business_process: Inpatient and swing-bed nursing care and medication administration
description: Nursing assessment, orders, eMAR with barcode scanning; average census 7
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Medication timing and dose safety; the downtime PC prints the MAR every 2 hours, so information older than 2 hours is the practical limit before paper MARs must be rebuilt
manual_workaround: Printed MAR from the downtime PC; paper MAR and order sheets; double-check high-alert medications
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-06 (scanners); SYS-07 (infusion pumps; monitors)

description: Pharmacist order review (on site 20 hours a week, telepharmacy after hours) and automated dispensing cabinets
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New orders need pharmacist review; dispensing cabinets need their server for profiles; override use without review raises error risk
manual_workaround: Cabinet override with nurse double-check; consultant pharmacist called in; paper order review
dependent_third_parties: Telepharmacy service; consultant pharmacist; cabinet vendor

description: Chemistry, hematology, and point-of-care testing; results to the EHR through analyzer middleware; send-outs to the reference laboratory
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: ED and inpatient decisions depend on results within an hour; analyzers can run standalone but results must be phoned and hand-written
manual_workaround: Analyzers run standalone; results printed and phoned to the ED and nursing; paper requisitions
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (laboratory module); SYS-05 (middleware); SYS-07 (analyzers); SYS-04 interface engine

description: CT and X-ray acquisition, storage in the cloud imaging archive, and reads by the teleradiology group
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Stroke and trauma decisions need CT reads; without the archive link, images cannot reach the teleradiology group; beyond 8 hours CT-dependent ambulance traffic must be diverted
manual_workaround: CT stores studies locally for about 3 days; transfer patients needing emergent reads; X-ray reads by the ED physician with later over-read
dependent_third_parties: Teleradiology group; cloud provider; CT vendor

description: Patient registration, bed status, and coordination of transfers to regional hospitals
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New patients cannot be registered in the EHR; transfers need records and phone coordination
manual_workaround: Paper registration with downtime medical record numbers; transfer packet; phone and fax
dependent_third_parties: EHR vendor; receiving hospitals; cloud fax service

description: Charge capture, coding, claims, remittance; about $540,000 billed a week
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow; payers accept late claims within filing limits; Medicare interim payments cushion delay
manual_workaround: Queue charges; submit after recovery; cash reserves (60 days)

description: Electronic laboratory reporting, immunization, and syndromic surveillance feeds to the state health department
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reportable conditions have state deadlines; urgent reportable results can be phoned
manual_workaround: Phone and fax urgent reportable results; resend queued messages after recovery

description: Nurse call, HVAC (negative-pressure room, pharmacy and laboratory temperatures), medical gas alarms, generator monitoring
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Controllers run locally, but alarms and nurse call are safety functions; loss of remote monitoring needs staff on rounds; configuration changes are rare, so a weekly configuration export is enough
manual_workaround: Manual temperature and pressure rounds every 2 hours; bedside bells and hourly rounding if nurse call fails
dependent_third_parties: Building automation vendor; nurse call vendor

description: Release of information, coding support, record scanning, and downtime record reconciliation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Release-of-information deadlines are measured in days; reconciliation of downtime paper must finish before coding
manual_workaround: Hold requests; log paper records received during downtime

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding, and terminations (SaaS)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; missing payroll has legal and staffing retention impact in a tight rural labor market
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider

description: VoIP phones, mass text notification, email, EMS radio; coordination of diversion and transfers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Diversion, transfers, and staff call-in depend on phones; the phone system configuration changes rarely so a daily configuration backup is enough
manual_workaround: Analog lines in the ED and at the nursing station; EMS radio; personal cell phones with the printed contact list
